aliased.definition: SELECT b.id AS visible_id FROM base b

parenthesized.definition: SELECT (b.id) AS visible_id FROM base b

qualified_star.definition: SELECT b.*, 42 AS extra FROM base b

other_star.definition: SELECT r.* FROM base b LEFT JOIN related r ON r.id = b.id

composite.definition: SELECT b.tenant AS account, b.id AS item FROM base_composite b

computed.definition: SELECT id + 1 AS id FROM base

derived.definition: SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM base) b

column_alias.definition: SELECT renamed FROM base AS b(renamed)

cte.definition: WITH b AS (SELECT id FROM base) SELECT id FROM b

fetch.definition: SELECT id FROM base FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

cross.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b, related r

having.definition: SELECT id FROM base HAVING id > 0

group_all.definition: SELECT id FROM base GROUP BY ALL

left_literal.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN related r ON r.id = 1

left_reverse.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN related r ON b.id = r.id

left_composite.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN base_composite r ON (r.tenant = 1 AND b.id = r.id) AND r.tenant > 0

left_extra_equality.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN related r ON r.id = b.id AND b.tenant = 1

left_partial.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN base_composite r ON r.id = b.id

left_null.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN related r ON r.id = NULL

left_expression.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN related r ON r.id = b.id + 1

left_or.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN related r ON r.id = b.id OR r.id = 1

left_using.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN related r USING (id)

left_keyless.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN keyless r ON r.id = b.id

left_missing.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN missing r ON r.id = b.id

left_view.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN aliased r ON r.visible_id = b.id

left_derived.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN (SELECT id FROM related) r ON r.id = b.id

bare_join_projection.definition: SELECT id FROM base b LEFT JOIN related r ON r.id = b.id

wrong_qualifier.definition: SELECT r.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN related r ON r.id = b.id

right_join.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b RIGHT JOIN related r ON r.id = b.id

left_true.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN related r ON true

left_other_qualifier.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT JOIN related r ON r.id = absent.id

left_outer.definition: SELECT b.id FROM base b LEFT OUTER JOIN related r ON ((r.id = b.id))
